title: Lagoon temperature from influent and ambient air temperatures

symbols.definition: temperatures (°C) of influent sewage and ambient air respectively and
the heat transfer coefficient for aerated lagoons which is 0.49 m/day.

applicability: Estimates the temperature TL in a lagoon, used to compute the detention time required for the critical average winter month temperature.
notes: The equation prints a lower-case theta while the printed definition list prints a capital Θ; preserved as printed.
TL, the subject of the equation, has no definition in the printed list.
The printed list item ends with a stray "and" after "ambient air respectively"; preserved.
